commit-biologics-2026.tagline: A biotech building the BiCE platform that uses the complement system to eliminate pathogenic cells in cancer and autoimmune diseases.

Published over 220 papers and filed 50 patent applications. Recipient of the Danish Ministry of Science Elite Research Award.
founders.notable_achievement: Led Tidal Therapeutics to an acquisition by Sanofi and sold Nanovi to CQ Medical.

commit-biologics-2026.team_highlights: All four founders are young scientists from Aarhus University who researched the BiCE platform during evenings outside their main jobs. They later received early funding from the BioInnovation Institute (BII).

product.summary: Commit Biologics develops a bispecific antibody (BiCE™) platform that activates the complement system. When the antibody binds to a target cell surface, it directly recruits C1q protein to trigger the complement cascade, enabling rapid, T-cell-independent cell elimination.
product.problem_statement: Existing antibody therapeutics do not effectively activate complement, and T-cell-dependent therapies are less effective in patients with impaired T-cell function. In autoimmune diseases, they only suppress immune responses without eliminating pathogenic cells, limiting curative potential.
product.solution: BiCE™ antibodies are IgG-based, easy to manufacture, and stable. They maintain the safety profile of conventional antibodies while inducing potent complement activation only on target cells. In non-human primate studies, they rapidly and deeply eliminated target B cells with no systemic cytokine release observed.
key_features: Direct C1q recruitment for complement activation, T-cell independent
IgG-based modular design applicable to various targets
Potent cell elimination efficacy compared to conventional antibodies
Maintains safety, stability, and manufacturability
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Protein engineering design that directly lures C1q, the first step of the complement pathway, to the target cell surface. Overcomes the limitation of conventional antibodies requiring clustering in a specific arrangement to activate complement.
product.target_customer: Patients in oncology and autoimmune diseases. The first candidate, COM002, is set to initiate clinical trials in relapsed/refractory non-Hodgkin lymphoma, with future expansion into autoimmune indications.
product.business_model: Capital-efficient growth through internal pipeline development combined with collaborations/partnerships with large pharmaceutical companies. Future funding will be based on clinical data and investor demand.

direct_competitors.comparison: CD20-targeting antibodies use some complement-dependent cytotoxicity, but Commit's BiCE™ is designed with complement activation as its primary mechanism, making it more potent.

direct_competitors.name: Harpoon Therapeutics (T-cell engager)
direct_competitors.comparison: T-cell-dependent approach, with limited efficacy in patients with impaired T-cell function. Commit acts independently of T cells.

direct_competitors.name: MorphoSys (CD19 CAR-T, etc.)
direct_competitors.comparison: CAR-T is personalized, costly, and carries toxicity. Commit is an off-the-shelf antibody with a safety advantage.

competitive_landscape.key_differentiator: The first bispecific antibody platform leveraging the complement system as its primary driver. Eliminates cells without T-cell dependency, and the IgG-based design offers proven manufacturing and safety.
competitive_landscape.moat: Over 30 years of research history in complement biology at Aarhus University, providing exclusive know-how. Patents and technical expertise in protein design for efficient C1q recruitment. Efficacy and safety data already obtained in non-human primates.
competitive_landscape.competitive_position_summary: Few biotechs target complement, and Commit holds the most advanced clinical-stage complement-based bispecific antibody platform. Though early-stage, its unique approach has attracted attention.

product.summary: CANDiY AI (HyPAA) is a hyper-personalized AI agent solution that operates and trains AI models inside the device without transferring user sensitive data to the cloud. It features a 'Personal Vault' that securely stores personal data and a personalized model based on federated learning, enabling enterprises to provide highly personalized AI services while complying with regulations.
product.problem_statement: Cloud-based AI requires transferring sensitive data (medical records, genomic information, insurance data) to external servers, leading to significant privacy, security, and regulatory risks. Generic models fail to reflect individual user contexts and habits, resulting in lower accuracy. Additionally, cloud infrastructure costs and communication burdens from large-scale data transmission exist.
product.solution: Adopted an on-device AI architecture where all data processing and model training occur on the device (edge/on-premise). The proprietary 'Hyper-Personalized Federated Learning' technology enables collaborative learning among users while solving the problem of individual characteristics being averaged out. It generates a personalized foundation model using class-wise federated averaging, retrains with device data, and shares AI parameters among similar users to adapt to changing contexts.
key_features: On-device AI processing that keeps data on the device
Generation of personalized foundation model (class-wise federated averaging)
Hyper-personalization through retraining with device data
Sharing of AI parameters among users with similar profiles
Personal Vault: A personal data repository accessible only with an encryption key
Modular components (data collection, encrypted storage, consent management) for flexible integration
Multi-agent architecture (chatbot, voicebot, etc.)
75% reduction in learning costs and 88% reduction in server-device communication compared to existing SaaS (self-measured)
Minimized communication burden through lightweight techniques
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: The core technology is 'Hyper-Personalized Federated Learning', which introduces class-wise federated averaging to solve the problem of individual characteristic averaging that occurs in existing federated learning. It also retrains the foundation model with data from each device and establishes a three-step personalization process that shares parameters among similar users. Lightweight models reduce communication costs, and the Personal Vault ensures security in on-device, cloud, and on-premise environments. Research results have been accepted at ICCV 2025 and AAAI 2026.
product.target_customer: Initially supplying to insurance companies (DB Life) and medical institutions (Dongguk University Ilsan Hospital, Asan Medical Center), and expanding into regulated industries handling sensitive data such as finance, logistics, robotics, and defense. Internationally, collaborating with European telecom operators (Vodafone) and semiconductor companies (Qualcomm).

The acceptance of research papers at ICCV and AAAI also attests to the technological prowess.

While global big tech targets the consumer market, SAKAK is pursuing a strategy to preempt the B2B sensitive data market in this niche.

product.summary: Routant is a zero-trust access control layer that provides granular permission control when AI agents access customer's internal systems (private apps, databases, APIs).

onetriangle-2026.tagline: KV cache transfer inference platform to reduce inference costs

founders.notable_achievement: NeurIPS/ICML paper author, International Physics and Astronomy Olympiad medalist

onetriangle-2026.team_highlights: Team of 4 MIT engineers with experience at Google DeepMind, Jane Street, and SpaceX; includes NeurIPS/ICML authors and International Physics and Astronomy Olympiad medalists

product.summary: An inference optimization solution that transfers prefill results of a small model to a large model via KV cache transfer, dramatically reducing inference cost and latency.
product.problem_statement: The prefill phase of large language models dominates inference cost in long-context and agent workloads, leading to excessive cost and time.
product.solution: By performing prefill with a small model, mapping and transferring the KV cache to the large model's space, the solution achieves a 20% reduction in prefill cost and 40% improvement in TTFT without quality loss.
key_features: KV cache transfer from small to large model after prefill
Learned cache mapper that minimizes KL divergence (superior to NVIDIA's paper)
Supports the entire open-weight model ecosystem (Qwen3, LLaMA, DeepSeek, etc.)
Plans to upstream into vLLM, requiring no changes to existing infrastructure
Provides dedicated endpoints and GPU-equipped service
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: KV cache transfer removes positional encoding, maps to the large model's space, and restores importance weighting via a learned mapper. On 4×H100, TTFT improves by over 10x for 1M context.
product.target_customer: Companies operating cloud GPUs, large-scale inference service providers, AI teams handling agent workloads
product.business_model: Dedicated endpoint rental, software deployment on customer-owned GPUs, usage-based pricing (per input/output token, e.g., DeepSeek V4 Flash at $0.15 per million input tokens)

direct_competitors.comparison: NVIDIA also published KV cache transfer research, but OneTriangle achieved lower KL divergence in just 2 weeks, claiming a technical edge.
OneTriangle plans to upstream its technology into vLLM, making it more a collaborative than competitive relationship.

competitive_landscape.key_differentiator: First commercialized KV cache transfer technology that can practically reduce prefill costs of large models by up to 90%, differentiating it from existing inference optimization platforms.
competitive_landscape.moat: Patentable cache mapping technology, influence within the vLLM community, domain expertise of MIT researchers, YC network
competitive_landscape.competitive_position_summary: Despite early stage, the company is rapidly acquiring customers after YC Demo Day based on technical advantage; direct competition with large cloud vendors is yet to come.
